definition: Compensation paid by a corponation to the surviving family of an employee killed during a sanctioned operation — typically a lump sum designed to suppress litigation and maintain silence. Often insultingly small. Used sarcastically to describe any hollow consolation prize.
origin: Corporate HR jargon, leaked from Arcturus Defense Solutions internal documents
usage: Wage slaves, labor organizers, Tier 2-3 families, underworld fixers
example: Forty thousand quanta and a company letter — that's the grief dividend they sent Tomás's mother after Arcturus sent him into a hot zone with no armor rating.
